generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on E-GMP: 110.3 kWh NCM pack; 10-80% in about 24 min on a 350 kW charger. Wikipedia gives no vehicle DC peak kW and does not mention the port; the Ioniq 9 is understood to ship with NACS in North America but I did not verify that here. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyundai_Ioniq_9 ; https://electrek.co/2026/11/11/hyundai-shaking-up-2027-ev-lineup-whats-changing/
